text:
David (Partnerships): quick sync - SI partner asked what minimum SOC/pen evidence we need for marketplace listing and how to package HW attachments. also who owns redaction + presign flow?
Maya (Security PM): +1. propose minimal: SOC2 Type II within 12 months OR (SOC2 Type I + signed attestation + external pen-test exec summary). no raw creds/logs allowed.
Samir (SI Eng): from SI side, bundle normally: firmware checksums, deployment diagram, signed attestation PDF, pen-test executive summary. prefer a single ZIP plus a metadata CSV that maps filenames -> evidence_type.
Jen (Legal): SOC2 Type II preferred. If only Type I, require compensating attestation signed by an officer and a completed security questionnaire. we also need an indemnity checkbox on the listing.
David (Partnerships): so "minimum parity" = (A) SOC2 Type II OR (B) SOC2 Type I + attestation + pen-test exec summary + completed questionnaire. sound ok?
Maya (Security PM): thats workable. pen-test must be within 18 months and include a CVSS-style findings summary (no PII).
Samir (SI Eng): upload flow note: partners want presigned links. recommend inbound presign TTL = 7 days for ingestion. partner uploads ZIP to their secure location, we consume via presigned PUT/POST. extension by exception.
Jen (Legal): 7 days presign fine. once ingested, retention: store archived artifact in our compliance bucket with restricted access and 7-year retention. tag artifacts with owner and redaction status.
Partner Ops Bot: Created ticket #PRT-4821 "Integrator evidence ingest - SOC + pen alignment" assigned to @Maya ETA 2026-04-02
Maya (Security PM): action items: 1) draft minimum-evidence checklist, 2) add attestation language in marketplace docs, 3) define presign TTL and ingestion playbook. owning. target EOD 2026-03-30.
Samir (SI Eng): i'll prototype metadata CSV schema. sample columns: filename,evidence_type,control_reference,redacted,contact_email,redaction_notes. example CSV snippet:
filename,evidence_type,control_reference,redacted,contact_email,redaction_notes
firmware_hashes.txt,artifact,INF-3,false,eng@si.example.com,
soc2_attestation.pdf,attestation,CC-1,true,security@si.example.com,"removed sensitive org IDs"
pentest_exec_summary.pdf,pen-test,SEC-4,true,security@si.example.com,"redacted ip ranges"
Maya (Security PM): include field for redaction rationale and list of redacted patterns.
David (Partnerships): partners ask about export control / HW-sensitive fields. we should explicitly forbid keys, raw telemetry, or customer-identifiable logs. provide a redaction guide and sample sed/grep rules.
Jen (Legal): add signed attestation checkbox: "No production keys or customer PII included in uploaded artifacts." require brief description of redaction steps in metadata.
Samir (SI Eng): pen-test scope requirement: must state network/service boundary for integrated offering plus list of excluded assets. vendor name + date + CVSS summary ok. no raw test logs required.
Maya (Security PM): acceptance criteria for ingestion: CSV present and matches ZIP, signed attestation PDF present, pen-test exec summary within 18 months, redaction_notes present for any redacted file, presigned link TTL honored, owner contact provided.
David (Partnerships): propose small compliance gating step in listing UI where partner checks boxes and uploads artifacts; Ops triggers automated ingest to compliance bucket.
Jen (Legal): i'll draft attestation text covering validity period, redaction statement, and permission to retain artifacts for audits.
Samir (SI Eng): automation plan: ingestion job validates CSV<->ZIP, runs file-type checks, flags missing redaction notes, and posts results back to ticket. i'll add validation scripts to repo.
Maya (Security PM): timeline recap: checklist + playbook by 2026-03-30 (me), metadata prototype + validation by 2026-04-01 (Samir), attestation text by 2026-03-31 (Jen). David will coordinate partner comms after docs.
David (Partnerships): last ask: standardize a minimal redaction template for partners. Samir/Maya can we pull one from prior vendor onboarding?
Samir (SI Eng): yes, i'll attach a short redaction template to PRT-4821 and include sample sed/grep rules for removing keys and PII.
Maya (Security PM): i'll add a mapping task to correlate SOC controls to our marketplace control catalog for reviewers.
Jen (Legal): ping me on the draft attestation. i'll review quickly.
David (Partnerships): great, i'll reply to partner with this plan and link the ticket. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
